acquisition_method.evidence: inferred: Data dependent mode selected the most abundant precursor ions possible in 2 s cycle time followed by 45 s exclusion and ions were isolated in the quadrupole with a 1.2 m/z window.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Alkylation was conducted by replacing the DTT solution with 55 mm IAA (Sigma) and incubated at 22 °C for 20 min in the dark followed by washing with 50% ethanol in 50 mm ABC at 22 °C, for 15 min and dehydrated with 100% ethanol for 5 min .

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Alkylation was conducted by replacing the DTT solution with 55 mm IAA (Sigma) and incubated at 22 °C for 20 min in the dark followed by washing with 50% ethanol in 50 mm ABC at 22 °C, for 15 min and dehydrated with 100% ethanol for 5 min .

cleavage_agent.evidence: Enzyme specificity was trypsin with a maximum of two missed cleavages.

collision_energy.evidence: Precursor ions were fragmented with higher energy C‐trap dissociation (HCD), normalised collision energy of 33% and fixed first mass of 120 m/z.

fractionation_method.evidence: All samples were run in 10% SDS‐PAGE mini‐gels until the dye front was 1 cm from the bottom for higher reproducibility.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Precursor ions were fragmented with higher energy C‐trap dissociation (HCD), normalised collision energy of 33% and fixed first mass of 120 m/z.

ionization_type.evidence: Electrospray used a static Nanospray‐Flex with a stainless steel emitter OD 1/32’ in positive mode at 2.1 kV (Thermo‐Scientific).

labeling.evidence: Label‐free protein quantification (LFQ) was calculated if a minimum of two peptides was compared between different samples.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: MS survey scans from 375 to 1575 m/z, with a 2 × 105 ion count target, maximum injection time of 150 ms, and resolution of 120 000 at 200 m/z, acquired in profile mode were performed in the Orbitrap analyser.
